content.value_statement: Computer vision projects often fail when model choices ignore data quality, latency, deployment, or monitoring constraints. This skill structures architecture, optimization, and production planning around those constraints.
actual_capabilities: Recommends architecture patterns for scalable image and video processing workloads.
Defines measurable latency, throughput, availability, and error-rate targets.
Structures object detection optimization work with profiling, testing, and monitoring priorities.
Plans model serving with batching, caching, load balancing, and autoscaling considerations.
Reviews privacy and operational needs, including access control, encryption, audit logging, and drift monitoring.
limitations: The included Python tools are scaffolds and do not train models, optimize inference, or build datasets.
The references provide general guidance rather than model-specific implementations or configurations.
Performance targets are examples and require validation on representative hardware and data.
The skill does not replace dataset inspection, model evaluation, security review, or production testing.

use_cases.title: Select a Vision Baseline
use_cases.description: Compare model families, dataset needs, evaluation metrics, and deployment constraints before starting experiments.

use_cases.title: Improve Detection Performance
use_cases.description: Create a prioritized plan for improving detector accuracy, latency, throughput, and reliability.

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Assess serving, monitoring, privacy, scaling, and incident-response requirements for a vision service.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to detect [objects] in [image or video source]. Recommend a baseline architecture, dataset plan, metrics, and first experiment.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Detector
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this object detection setup: [details]. Identify likely accuracy and latency limits. Propose prioritized experiments with measurable success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Real-Time Serving
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an inference service for [model] with [traffic and latency targets]. Cover batching, caching, scaling, observability, fallback behavior, and cost tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Conduct an Architecture Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this vision platform architecture: [details]. Evaluate data flow, model lifecycle, privacy, reliability, capacity, and incident risks. Rank recommendations by impact.

output_examples.input: Recommend a baseline for detecting small defects on a factory line with limited labeled data.
output: Start with a pretrained one-stage detector and preserve higher input resolution for small defects.
Use stratified splits by production batch to prevent leakage.
Track class recall, false positives per image, and end-to-end latency.
Compare targeted augmentation and active learning before increasing model size.

output_examples.input: Reduce inference latency from 180 milliseconds to less than 100 milliseconds.
output: Profile preprocessing, model execution, transfer time, and postprocessing separately.
Test mixed precision, fixed input shapes, and larger batches under realistic concurrency.
Validate every optimization against accuracy and tail-latency thresholds.
Record hardware, runtime, model version, and dataset for reproducible comparisons.

output_examples.input: Review a planned production vision service handling personal images.
output_examples.output: The review prioritizes data minimization, encryption, access control, retention limits, audit logging, model monitoring, capacity tests, and a documented incident process.

best_practices: Define accuracy, latency, throughput, reliability, privacy, and cost targets before selecting a model.
Profile the complete pipeline on representative data and deployment hardware.
Monitor input quality, prediction quality, drift, resource use, and service health after release.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize model execution while ignoring preprocessing, transfer, and postprocessing costs.
Do not accept generic performance targets without workload-specific benchmarks.
Do not deploy a vision model without data governance, monitoring, rollback, and incident procedures.

faq.question: Does this skill train a model automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance, while the included Python trainer is only a scaffold.

faq.question: Which computer vision frameworks does it cover?
faq.answer: The documentation references PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV-related workflows, YOLO, SAM, diffusion models, and vision transformers at a general level.

faq.question: Can it optimize an existing inference service?
faq.answer: It can structure profiling and optimization recommendations. You must provide measurements, architecture details, hardware, and quality constraints.

faq.question: Does it support real-time video systems?
faq.answer: Yes, as an architecture and operations guide covering latency, batching, caching, scaling, and monitoring.

faq.question: Can it guarantee the listed performance targets?
faq.answer: No. The targets are examples and must be tested against your data, traffic, model, runtime, and hardware.

faq.question: Does it address privacy and security?
faq.answer: It highlights encryption, access control, anonymization, audit logging, and compliance considerations. A dedicated review is still required for production.
